name: University of Sussex crystallization platform (BBSRC ALERT; robot with LCP, large-capacity imager, microfluidic screen builder; 2022)
brief: A university crystallization facility replaces and expands its set-up with an integrated platform: a crystallization robot with lipidic cubic phase capability, an advanced large-capacity automated crystal imaging system, and a next-generation microfluidic liquid handler for building crystallization screens, all under integrated software.

cost.excludes_note: Award value of the BBSRC equipment grant on UKRI Gateway to Research. Whether it includes VAT, service contracts, install or housing is not stated. The USD figure is my conversion.

notes: No workflow: the award names no makes or models. Opened the Gateway to Research API 3 Oct 2026: 'Sussex Crystallization Platform for Bioscience discovery' (Univ. Sussex), fund GBP 715,568, 2022-08 to 2023-07. Abstract: "The platform platform has integrated software and comprises a crystallization robot, an advanced large capacity automated crystal imaging system and a next-generation liquid handler for crystallization screen building." WEAK CASE: the abstract names no makes or models, so mapping is a guess (likely Formulatrix NT8/mosquito LCP, Rock Imager, and a Formulatrix Mantis/Tempest-class handler) and is left as catalog_id null except by-function guesses flagged in the names. 0 of 3 confirmed; 3 of 3 plausible. Use only as a function-level prediction target (does our designer produce ~one dispenser + one large imager + one screen-builder at roughly this price?). Capacity of the imager is not stated.
